data.name: Poker Omaha
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the world of Poker Omaha No Limit - where every decision matters!

Think you’ve mastered poker? Omaha raises the stakes. Four hole cards, five community cards, and no limits — this is the game for players who love to think ahead and aren’t afraid of bold moves.

Poker Omaha is a free multiplayer game where you’ll face real players from all over the world — no risk, just pure strategy and excitement at the table.

Why Poker Omaha No Limit is for you

· 4 hole cards — plan, calculate, surprise
· No Limit — go all-in when you feel the edge
· Multiplayer — thousands of active players and full tables 24/7
· Daily bonuses — guaranteed chip boost every day
· Advanced stats & leaderboards — climb to the top and show who runs the table
· Missions — complete challenges and earn extra rewards
· Elite Rings & Jackpot Arena Trophies — grow your collection and win prizes
· VIP Status — the higher your level, the greater the perks

Game Modes

· Cash Tables — various stakes, full control over the game pace
· Jackpot Arena — two-stage Turbo tournaments
· Sit & Go, Freerolls, and many other scheduled tournaments

Omaha No Limit vs Texas Hold’em

Texas Hold’em
→ 2 cards, simpler combinations
→ Perfect for beginners

Omaha No Limit
→ 4 cards, dozens of possibilities
→ Deeper strategy, higher intensity
→ For players who crave a real challenge

Four cards. One challenge.

Ready to see if you’ve got what it takes to become an Omaha champion?
Download Poker Omaha No Limit and show you can play without limits!
Play for free now!

***Important***

This game is intended for entertainment purposes only and does not offer real-money gambling or prizes. Downloading and playing are free, but the app offers optional in-game purchases for additional chips.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD 4000 graphics or better (WebGL 2.0 support)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with WebGL 2.0 support (Intel HD 4000 or newer)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
